question.text: When a PMS subscribes to an IPO on behalf of clients:

answer.text: The PM can pool all HNI subscriptions under its own name
Each client's subscription is made in the client's own name/account via ASBA

explanation.text: The Logic: Client-specific subscriptions are made in client names via ASBA; segregation is required. The Trap: Pooling or PM-name subscriptions breach PMS rules. Cross-Exam Context: Same in III-A, VII. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Run the IPO subscription through OMS with client-wise ASBA mandates.
